Hi Alice —

Thanks again for taking the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps on the data handling items we discussed: 

- You requested that Acme opt out of any use of Acme data for model training and improvement outside of inference. Redwood will not use customer-provided content for downstream model training when an opt-out is in place.
- Data residency: your production inference workload will be pinned to us-west-2; we will not replicate logs to other regions without prior approval.
- Logging controls: we'll limit retention of request/response logs to 30 days for the environments you specified and provide filtered access to metadata only.
- PII handling: we acknowledged the need to minimize retention of direct PII fields; we'll apply redaction filters on request logs where feasible and provide the extraction/export for your audits.

Attached is the standard Training Opt-Out form we use to formalize this. If you confirm, we will: 1) mark the account in our system as "training_opt_out", 2) update routing/retention policies for the production route, and 3) notify infra & compliance to enforce the retention limits.
